verdict.rationale: The evidence describes only the SOSPortal web interface for filing, ordering, searching and tracking, plus downloadable PDF forms. Nothing documents a public programmatic API, and the filing host's robots.txt bans AI agents by name. A government filing service could plausibly offer a public API, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence of one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
